body.message:
Hello,

This is a final follow-up regarding the outstanding AED 1,400.

Despite multiple requests, we have not received a substantive response.

To be clear:

– No issue was recorded at the time of check-out  
– No signed inspection report exists  
– The claim was introduced only after departure  
– The provided invoice does not establish tenant responsibility  

Therefore, the deduction remains unjustified.

Unless the remaining AED 1,400 is transferred today, we will proceed with updating the DET case accordingly and pursue further action.

We would prefer to resolve this amicably today.

Please confirm once the transfer is completed.

Regards,  
Mikhail Kantsavenka
